University programs.pay: $600 a week + up to $1,000 for supplies or travel

University programs.title: BRIDGE UP Summer Research Program
University programs.org: University of Utah, Center for Clinical and Translational Science
University programs.summary: 10 weeks of summer translational research with clinical shadowing, for students from colleges with limited research opportunities.

Hand-checked programs.org: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

Hand-checked programs.title: NASA OSTEM Internships (summer 2027)
Hand-checked programs.summary: Short-term paid internships at NASA centers. Applicants must be US citizens, at least 18, with a GPA of 3.0 or higher. Summer 2027 deadline March 1, 2027; fall 2027 deadline May 24, 2027.

Hand-checked programs.title: Ernest F. Hollings Undergraduate Scholarship
Hand-checked programs.summary: Academic support of up to $9,500 a year for two years, plus a paid 10-week NOAA summer internship ($700 a week). Applications open through January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM Eastern.
Hand-checked programs.pay: $700 a week internship + up to $9,500 a year

Hand-checked programs.title: Amgen Scholars (US program)
Hand-checked programs.summary: Summer research program in science and biotechnology at host universities. Summer 2027 applications are due February 1, 2027. Check the US program page for stipend and eligibility. Host universities include Howard University, an HBCU.

Hand-checked programs.title: SMART Scholarship-for-Service
Hand-checked programs.summary: Full tuition, a yearly stipend and summer internships, followed by a job with the Department of War after graduation. Check the official site for this cycle's dates and eligibility.

Hand-checked programs.title: NASA MUREP (Minority University Research and Education Project)
Hand-checked programs.summary: NASA's program for HBCUs, Tribal Colleges and other minority-serving institutions: research funding for schools and opportunities for their students. Check the page for current student opportunities.

Submitted.title: ORNL Pathways to Computing Internship Program (PCIP) - Summer 2027

Participants work alongside research staff and gain access to ORNL's world-class computing facilities. The program provides a weekly stipend, housing assistance, and travel reimbursement for non-local students.
Submitted.citizenship: Currently enrolled full-time undergraduate students returning for Fall 2027.

Submitted.title: The Green Teams Program 2027
Submitted.org: Montclair State University, PSEG Institute for Sustainability Studies
Submitted.summary: Full-time, 11-week summer internship where teams of five students from different majors work on sustainability projects for companies, nonprofits, towns and community groups. Interns train on campus, visit host sites and finish with a report and group presentation.
Submitted.citizenship: Upper-level undergraduates from any major with an interest in sustainability

Submitted.title: CALIBIR Summer Research Internship
Submitted.org: Wake Forest University School of Medicine
Submitted.summary: The CALIBIR Summer Research Internship is an NIH-funded 10-week program offering undergraduate and master's students hands-on research experience in translational artificial intelligence and biomedical informatics. Interns participate in professional development, seminars, and collaborative research projects while receiving hourly pay and on-campus housing.
Submitted.citizenship: Enrolled US undergrad/master's students, 18+, min 3.0 GPA, completed at least two semesters, not graduating before May 2027.

Submitted.title: Computer Science Research Internship Program

Submitted.citizenship: See official page
